findings.title: Specific written authorization required for sub-processors
findings.deviation: Clause 4.1 requires prior specific written authorization for each sub-processor instead of the standard general written authorization.
findings.impact: This imposes an administrative burden and could cause project delays by requiring individual client sign-off for every tool or service provider AtliQ uses.
findings.quote: The Processor shall not engage another processor without the Controller's prior specific written authorisation.
findings.counterPosition: AtliQ should have general written authorization to engage sub-processors, subject to notifying the client and providing a right to object.

findings.title: No sub-processors currently authorized
findings.deviation: The agreement states that no sub-processors are authorized as of the effective date.
findings.impact: AtliQ is effectively barred from using any of its existing infrastructure, cloud providers, or the Pune-based entity for this project until they are formally approved.
findings.quote: No sub-processors are authorised at the date of this Annex.
findings.counterPosition: Include an appendix listing AtliQ’s standard sub-processors (including the India-based delivery center and cloud providers) for pre-approval.

findings.title: Reference to uncapped liability in Services Agreement
findings.deviation: Clause 8.1 links liability to Section 9 of the Services Agreement, which currently lacks a liability cap.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited financial exposure for any data processing incidents or breaches under this Annex.
findings.quote: Liability under this Annex is governed by § 9 of the Services Agreement.
findings.counterPosition: Ensure the main Services Agreement contains a 1x fees aggregate liability cap, and include a 2x fees super-cap specifically for data protection liabilities.

fine.note: Section 3.1 correctly requires data processing personnel to be bound by confidentiality obligations.
The 48-hour breach notification period and annual audit frequency are within market standards.
The 30-day requirement to delete data and certify completion matches AtliQ's standard.
